ExploreFact.Text: Some things from previous universes can get transferred into the next one through the Eye of the Universe.
This shard seems to give off a more distorted signal than other quantum shards.

AltText.Text: This shard gives off a more distorted signal than other quantum shards due to it's origin from the previous universe.

ExploreFact.Text: When I shine my flashlight through the shard, it seems to have a form of interference within it.

AltText.Text: When I shine my flashlight through the shard, it shows an encoded sequence of stars dying from the previous universe.

ExploreFact.Text: Apparently Slate is scared of rocks. Will report to Hornsfeld immediately.

RumorFact.Text: The empty pedestal found in the Low-Light Observation Chamber looks like it used to hold the shard in place, but has since been relocated.

ExploreFact.Text: I've found a Nomai testing facility located on Brittle Hollow that is named the "Low-Light Observation Chamber".
It appears that this facility was used to test light behavior in objects.

AltText.Text: It appears that this facility was used to test the strange interference found inside the shard found on Timber Hearth.
